knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Scratches hold soil and make later cleaning harder.
Left-behind items and displaced parts create hazards.

practicalCriteria: Removes residue on a sample part using the approved method, without scratching.
Reassembles the sample part in its original position without force.
Stops and escalates a simulated displaced hose or torn seal.
passRule: Residue removed without damage, reassembly correct, and displaced connection or torn seal escalated. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Displaced connection repositioned by the cleaner
Appliance closed with an item left inside
